title: Review of Violation Fines Billed on a Parking License
content:
Parking receivable accounting standard for violation fines on a Parking License: the fine under review, its scheduled fine, and the correction credited against it.

## Clause

The fine under review is the most recent fine billed on the license within 3 months before the handling date; fines billed earlier stand as billed. Other fines of the license are counted over the 12 months before the handling date. The class amount is the product's violation fine amount, and the scheduled fine is the class amount. The correction credited against the fine is the amount billed for it less the scheduled fine, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Condition | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| a fine was billed on the license within the 3 months before the handling date | the most recent such fine is under review | correction: amount billed less the scheduled fine, never below zero |
| no fine was billed on the license within those 3 months | no fine is under review; earlier fines stand as billed | nothing is credited |

## Worked examples (hypothetical product whose violation fine amount is $50.00)

| Amount billed for the fine under review | Scheduled fine (the class amount) | Correction |
|---|---|---|
| $50.00 | $50.00 | $0.00 |
| $65.00 | $50.00 | $15.00 |
| $40.00 | $50.00 | $0.00 (never below zero) |

In the second row, $65.00 less $50.00 leaves $15.00 to be credited against the fine.
